sn35.239:1.1: tīhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhasomanassabahulo viharati, yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
sn35.239:1.3: indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, bhojane mattaññū, jāgariyaṃ anuyutto.
sn35.239:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti:
sn35.239:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti, nānubyañjanaggāhī,
sn35.239:2.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ. tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati;
sn35.239:2.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
sn35.239:2.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sn35.239:2.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ cātummahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa odhastapatodo: tamenaṃ dakkho yoggācariyo assadammasārathi abhirūhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā, dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā, yenicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyapi paccāsāreyyapi.
sn35.239:2.11: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ ārakkhāya sikkhati. saññamāya sikkhati, damāya sikkhati, upasamāya sikkhati.
sn35.239:2.12: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
sn35.239:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti:
sn35.239:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhāyoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti:
sn35.239:3.3: ‘neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti.
sn35.239:3.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso vaṇaṃ ālimpeyya. yāvadeva ropanatthāya seyyathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāvadeva bhārassa nittharaṇatthāya;
sn35.239:3.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhāyoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti.
sn35.239:3.6: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya, na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
sn35.239:3.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti.
sn35.239:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti:
sn35.239:4.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti,
sn35.239:4.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.239:4.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
sn35.239:4.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
sn35.239:4.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
sn35.239:4.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhasomanassabahulo viharati: yoni cassa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
